subject: Important Update: Your Upcoming Flight Details
body: Dear [Recipient], We wanted to inform you about some changes to your upcoming flight. Your flight schedule has been updated, and we have sent you the revised itinerary via email. Please review the details carefully to avoid any inconvenience. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact our customer service team. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. Best regards, The Airline Team
